agents.output: Position Build a premium for target users with a clear operational clarity and revenue protection value proposition, activation checklist, retention loop, and subscription-ready path.
Use a dashboard-first flow with guided onboarding, searchable work area, resilient empty states, and low-friction recovery paths.
Create a non-generic executive SaaS console system with restrained surfaces, strong hierarchy, consistent spacing, and trust-forward status cues.
Build typed App Router pages with responsive grids, stateful interactions, accessible controls, and no dead buttons.
Use safe local persistence and exportable project files; keep the architecture stable without depending on unavailable services.
Reuse warehouse systems: Search and filters, Export-ready source, Working onboarding.
Attack routes, buttons, onboarding, empty states, persistence, responsiveness, and release claims before approval.
standards: Force repair loop on weak output

agents.output: Keep the first screen light, use memoized filtering, avoid expensive render loops, and make status feedback immediate.
Validate file paths, avoid unsafe secrets, use fail-safe persistence reads, and keep destructive actions explicit.
Add activation, habit, trust, and upgrade cues so Build a premium is commercially believable.

critiques.issue: Onboarding must prove first value in three steps or fewer.

critiques.issue: Dashboard hierarchy cannot look like a generic template.
critiques.resolution: Frontend uses compact cards, dark readiness panel, and distinct agent-plan surface.

critiques.issue: Activation and monetization need to appear in-product.
critiques.resolution: Product plan includes upgrade logic and retention metrics.

critiques.issue: Persistence must fail safely without breaking the UI.
critiques.resolution: Backend pattern uses guarded local persistence and scoped file paths.

designMemory.title: Actionable empty states
designMemory.summary: Empty states must explain the next action and include a working command.

featureMemory.title: Search and filters
featureMemory.summary: Reusable search/filter controls for dashboards, lists, and warehouses.
evidence: Appears across generated project management flows
featureMemory.reusableAsset: Controlled input + tag filter + result count

featureMemory.title: Export-ready source
featureMemory.summary: Generated apps include package metadata and source files that can be downloaded.

featureMemory.title: Working onboarding
featureMemory.summary: Generated products should include a short setup path connected to the main dashboard.

bugMemory.title: Buttons without handlers
bugMemory.summary: Static buttons make generated apps feel fake.
evidence: Observed in early generated app shells
bugMemory.issue: Generated buttons rendered but did not perform an action.
bugMemory.rootCause: UI shell generation did not require event handlers or navigation targets.
bugMemory.fix: Require every button to bind onClick, submit, href, or disabled loading state.
bugMemory.prevention: Before generation, apply the rule: never generate buttons without action binding.

bugMemory.title: Blank generated pages
bugMemory.summary: Pages without data, loading, and empty states fail launch readiness.
bugMemory.issue: Generated route existed but rendered an empty shell.
bugMemory.rootCause: Missing default content and state wiring.
bugMemory.fix: Require meaningful first screen, empty state, and action path.
bugMemory.prevention: Score launch readiness below 85 when app/page.tsx or core content is missing.

generationMemory.title: Reuse before regenerate
generationMemory.summary: Check warehouse winners, features, components, and bug rules before creating new files.

generationMemory.title: 85+ auto-improvement loop
generationMemory.summary: Score outputs across ten quality dimensions and revise anything below threshold.

qualityMemory.title: Launch threshold 85
qualityMemory.summary: Apps under 85 are treated as needing improvement before promotion.

qualityMemory.title: Required interactions
